en: The postcard consists of two sides. The front shows a black-and-white photograph of a rural landscape with a prominent church building labeled 'Timrå Kyrka.' The church features a tall tower and is situated among fields, trees, and scattered houses, with hills in the background. The description at the bottom says 'Timrå Kyrka.' published by G. H. Malmberg, Yxstavarp. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Swedish, a green Swedish 5 öre stamp with a portrait, multiple headings in different languages indicating it is a postcard, and a postmark. The card is addressed to 'Herr S. P. Göransson, Södermalmsg 12, Sundsvall'. Additional handwritten correspondence is present.
